description: This is a Sole Source Justification pertaining to solicitation 36C24126Q0334 for construction project 650-23-103. This solicitation is being presented to Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC) holders. A component of this solicitation requires a brand name piece of equipment to be compatible with existing systems, resulting in a sole source need. In the spirit of transparency, the VA is posting the sole source justification for the public to review. Please find the sole source justification for the specific piece of equipment attached to this notice.
